title.zh: 电场 · 看不见的力画成图
title.en: Electric Fields · Drawing an Invisible Force

desc.zh: 从一个点电荷的场出发，叠加、画场线、画等势面，最后放一个电荷看它怎么动。
desc.en: Start with one point charge, then add fields, draw field lines and equipotentials, and finally release a charge to watch it move.
